description: The version history of an app, with a branch per environment: "pre" (every save burst is a commit) and "pro" (each neblla_promote is a merge of pre into it). Without its own repo Neblla keeps that git; linked to a GitHub repo (neblla_git), the history is that repo's pre and pro branches, read with the developer's token. "history" (branch?): the versions, newest first; "files" (commit, branch?): what one version holds. Changes nothing; neblla_versions restores and migrates.
name: neblla_versions_read
title: Versions (read)
